verdict.rationale: Cake documents board approval/e-signing automation (docs-10), NSO/ISO option issuance and vesting (docs-4, docs-5), and a 409A valuation offering (docs-8), covering the main pieces of the story, but no single doc describes these as one unified end-to-end workflow from new-hire grant through board approval to 409A-compliant strike price. missing for 10: explicit description of the integrated workflow linking hire issuance, board sign-off, and 409A strike pricing in one sequence, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
